text.content:
A priest who became a fixer.

Role: Fixer
Location: Heywood
Known for: Gigs that all seem to serve a long game of keeping Heywood in balance

Padre really was a priest before he left the clergy for what he calls a more noble calling. His gigs vary, but they all seem to be moves in a chess game meant to keep the peace in Heywood.

Gig hooks

  • Padre needs a Valentinos lieutenant kept alive until Sunday.

Edgerunner's Handbook (Edgerunners Mission Kit), p.27
